description: A museum is lending objects out and must assemble condition reports, packing instructions, courier notes, environmental requirements, and return conditions into one coherent outgoing loan packet.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old loans coordinator managing a complex inter-institutional shipment
user_profile.context: The objects are approved for travel, but the supporting documentation still lives in several separate work streams
user_profile.communication_style: Process-heavy and exact, wants every shipping and return requirement tied to the right object

fact_sheet.fact: The outgoing loan is designated by the loan number L2024.15.
The borrower is the Galiano Art Institute, located at 1800 West Cliff Drive, Port Royal, CA 90210.
The loan period is from October 15, 2024, to April 15, 2025, inclusive of transit times.
The loan includes the 'Scythian Griffin Rhyton', a ceramic vessel with accession number AM-2011.45.1.
The loan includes 'The Vespucci Folio', a single-leaf manuscript with accession number AM-1998.12.3.
The loan includes the 'Dancing Satyr of Naxos', a bronze sculpture with accession number AM-1978.2.11.
The condition report for AM-2011.45.1, updated on September 5, 2024, by conservator Lena Petrova, notes a stable 2mm chip on the upper rim.
All condition report photography must be captured as 300 dpi TIFF files, with a color checker and scale included in each shot.
The Galiano Art Institute must submit their incoming condition report to Elara Vance within 24 hours of uncrating.
Handling of 'The Vespucci Folio' (AM-1998.12.3) requires powder-free nitrile gloves at all times.
The 'Scythian Griffin Rhyton' (AM-2011.45.1) is to be packed in Crate ATL-101, using a custom-cut Ethafoam L200 cavity mount.
The 'Vespucci Folio' (AM-1998.12.3) must be housed in a Mylar L-sleeve before being placed into its archival clamshell box.
The 'Dancing Satyr' (AM-1978.2.11) must have its base wrapped in Tyvek 1443R before being nested in its foam support.
All three objects will travel together in a single consolidated shipment under ArtTrans Logistics master waybill 880-19374652.
The required environmental conditions for all objects in transit and on display are 68-72°F (20-22°C).
The required relative humidity (RH) for all objects is 45-50%, with fluctuations not to exceed +/- 3% in a 24-hour period.
Light exposure for 'The Vespucci Folio' (AM-1998.12.3) must not exceed 5 foot-candles (50 lux).
Two HOBO MX1101 data loggers, serial numbers 20884591 and 20884592, must be activated and placed inside Crate ATL-101 prior to sealing.
The designated courier is Sofia Rossi from ArtTrans Logistics, reachable at +1-212-555-0188.
The shipment will travel on AirCargo flight AC788 from JFK to LAX on October 10, 2024.
Ground transport must be a dual-driver, climate-controlled, air-ride truck with GPS tracking.
The courier's approved per diem for meals and incidentals is $75 USD per day.
The primary contact at the lending institution is Elara Vance, Loans Coordinator, at evance@aethelburgmuseum.org.
The authorizing registrar at the Aethelburg Museum is Mr. Julian Croft, reachable at extension 4501.
The receiving registrar at the Galiano Art Institute is Dr. Kenji Tanaka, contactable at ktanaka@galianoinstitute.org.
In case of emergency during transit, the first call is to the Aethelburg Museum 24-hour security desk at +1-212-555-0112.
The Galiano Art Institute's lead art handler for this loan is Maria Flores.
All official loan documents are stored on the shared network drive at the path: //AM-SERVER/Registrar/OutgoingLoans/L2024.15_Galiano.
Object records and condition reports are managed in the MuseionDB collections management system, accessible at https://cms.aethelburgmuseum.org/login.
The borrower must use the exact same crates and packing materials for the return shipment.
Return shipping arrangements must be initiated with ArtTrans Logistics no later than March 20, 2025.
